snippet.description:
Creating a nation of owners and helping you scale & buy profitable businesses.

I’m the CEO of Contrarian Thinking.
NYT bestselling author of Main Street Millionaire and bestseller Own or Be Owned. 
→ Owner: Resibrands, BizScout, Main St. Holding Co

This channel is your no-gatekeeping playbook for building wealth through real businesses.
Let’s take back Main Street.
